# RVL-CDIP-Classifier: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `Exios66/RVL-CDIP-Classifier` `6e55c0d` (14 October 2026) on 30 October 2026.

## Prompt versions

The case study's 29 registered prompt versions use labels v0 through v19. That is 20 labels. The remaining registrations are subversions, for example v11.8, not a twenty-first through twenty-ninth integer label.

## Tests

A line-start grep found 318 `def test_` functions. That matches the count already published on the case study's companion notes and was not a new pytest run.
